target: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md §108
review_type: read-only code and design security review
summary: Create and recovery are separate: recovery does not create and rejects missing/empty files; creation uses exclusive-create. JSONL size and parser checks largely match §108. However, a would-exceed append only sets an in-memory degraded flag, so a restart with a still-valid below-cap chain can reopen healthy unless the supervisor durably quarantines the case. The helper separately Lstats and opens by path rather than consuming the §3 verified handle; its check does not detect same-path replacement/file-ID mismatch or hard links. Windows mode checks are permissive by design and Windows parent-directory Sync is a no-op, both explicitly delegated to supervisor integration gates that are not present in this reviewed source. These are blockers to integration/security claims, not assertions that production code is reachable (the file is pilot_e2e build-tagged).

findings.title: Capacity-triggered degraded state is not restart-persistent
locations: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md:114
findings.evidence: A projected over-limit append sets only the in-memory s.degraded flag and writes no durable marker. Replay marks degraded only if the current sidecar size is already at least 1 MiB. If the existing valid file is smaller than the cap, restart can reopen it as healthy.
findings.risk: After a capacity rejection and process crash before cleanup, the supervisor may accept another command on the same case, contrary to §108 whole-case quarantine/cleanup semantics.
findings.required_action: Persist case quarantine/degraded state in the catalog before releasing the lifecycle lock; fail closed if persistence fails. Add cap-boundary restart tests for crashes before/after quarantine and assert no new command or chain recreation.

findings.title: Path-based Lstat/open does not implement verified-handle identity checks
locations: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md:42
findings.evidence: The helper Lstats a pathname and separately calls os.OpenFile, then checks only regular-file type and mode on the resulting handle. It does not pass/consume an OpenVerified handle, compare pre-open and opened file identity, use a no-follow open, or reject hardlinks itself.
findings.risk: A pathname or symlink swap between Lstat and OpenFile is not detected by this helper. The declared protected-parent/trusted-account model limits external exploitability, but the helper does not itself satisfy §3's verified-handle contract.
findings.required_action: Bind create/reopen to a supervisor-verified directory/file handle or equivalent atomic open and retain the case lock. Otherwise narrow the guarantee and enforce protected parent ACL/identity before every call. Never describe Lstat as atomic authorization.

findings.title: Windows DACL is not checked by the helper
locations: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md:114
findings.evidence: pilotSidecarModePrivate returns true for all Windows FileInfo values. The source comment delegates effective ACL validation to OpenVerified/supervisor; no such supervisor is included in the reviewed file set.
findings.required_action: Before each create/reopen, supervisor must verify owner-only DACL, inheritance, owner, link/reparse and file identity on the verified handle; do not claim Windows protection until integrated.

findings.title: Windows parent-directory durability is not implemented by this helper
locations: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md:114
findings.evidence: syncPilotSidecarParent returns nil on Windows without a directory-handle durability operation. The code comment and §108 correctly identify this as supervisor work.
findings.required_action: Implement and validate a supervisor-provided Windows parent-directory durability operation before claiming durable first-time creation.

findings.title: New-case-only creation is a comment/caller convention rather than an unforgeable API precondition
locations: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md:114
findings.evidence: createPilotStartSidecar accepts only path and key. O_EXCL protects an existing sidecar but cannot distinguish first initialization from an existing case whose sidecar was removed; in the latter case create succeeds and replay accepts the new empty chain.
findings.risk: A recovery caller that falls back to create can silently reset a missing sidecar chain, violating fail-closed recovery.
findings.required_action: Restrict creation to a supervisor operation carrying an opaque verified-new-case capability/handle; recovery code must call open only and must never fall back to create.

control_dispositions.create_reopen_split: correct for correct callers: create uses O_EXCL; recovery open does not create and rejects missing/empty files
control_dispositions.lstat_open_toctou: not atomically closed by helper; external exposure constrained only if protected parent and trusted-account model are enforced by supervisor
control_dispositions.windows_mode_permissiveness: explicitly delegated; mandatory DACL integration gate remains open
control_dispositions.parent_directory_sync: POSIX sync attempted; Windows is a no-op requiring supervisor durability integration
control_dispositions.jsonl_size_and_parser: 1 MiB total and 8 KiB line checks match; malformed/oversize replay fails closed; projected-cap failure needs durable quarantine across restart
control_dispositions.new_case_authorization: caller-convention only; must be supervisor-enforced or represented by an opaque capability

remaining_conditions: Make capacity-triggered quarantine durable before releasing the case lifecycle lock and verify restart refusal.
Use an OpenVerified handle/atomic supervisor open consistent with §3; enforce hardlink and file-identity checks.
Complete Windows DACL verification and parent-directory durability in supervisor integration.
Ensure only verified-new-case initialization can call create; no recovery fallback from open to create.
limitations: No tests or runtime validation were run.
No ACL, path race, hardlink, directory Sync, or process restart experiment was performed.
The file is pilot_e2e build-tagged; this review does not claim the code is in production builds or routes.
